title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_verified: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_applicable: Does not apply to this credential.
definitions.limited: Documented for a narrower case only.

providers.name: Twilio
providers.scope_notes: Twilio cloud APIs; PKCV needs Enterprise or Security Edition, OAuth apps are US1-only, and Monitor Events keeps 30 days (13 months with Administration, Security or Enterprise Edition).

controls.name: Token expiration time
controls.what: Sets access token lifetime from 1 minute to 30 days.
controls.setting: OAuth app > Access settings > Token expiration time

controls.name: Rotate secret (grace period 0) / delete OAuth app
controls.what: Invalidates old credentials and issued access tokens.
controls.setting: OAuth app > Credentials > Rotate secret; OAuth apps > Delete

controls_unknown: IP allowlisting for REST API credentials (Auth Token, API keys, OAuth).
Expiry settings for API keys and Auth Tokens.
Whether org SSO enforcement or SCIM deactivation affects any API credential.
Org-wide policy to block Main key or Auth Token use other than PKCV.
Whether Monitor Events records read (GET) API calls or token issuance.
Whether actor_sid identifies the API key SID (SK) or only the account.

auth_paths.name: Organization OAuth app (Client Credentials / Authorization Code)

authentication.summary: Only way to call organization-level APIs. Client credentials for machines; authorization code with refresh token on behalf of a user.

federation.details: Authorization code flow uses the user's Twilio sign-in; effect of SSO on refresh tokens not documented.

lifetime.summary: Token 1 min to 30 days, default 1 h

renewal.summary: Authorization code apps use a refresh token; client credentials apps re-request.

administration.summary: Organization Owner or Organization Admin manage org OAuth apps; delete under Organization API access.

sso.details: The Authorization Code consent page does not support SSO login; docs say to use an org admin whose SSO is deactivated.

inventory.details: Settings > Organization settings > Organization API access lists all organization OAuth apps.

usage.ui: Monitor > Insights > Audit > Audit Events Log

token_format.notes: Bearer access token; refresh token for authorization code apps.

anomaly_cues: New org OAuth apps with broad scopes

containment.steps: Delete the org OAuth app or rotate its secret with grace 0.

unknown: Org audit log for OAuth apps
